player_prompt.intro:
U na le Player {player_id} ka pheletsong ya Indian Poker.
- 52-card deck; u bona ka karata ya moahloli feela.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) hang ha round, {max_rounds} round(s) eohle.
- Tshebetso e halalela: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X ke nomoro e phahameng ya <= ya chipe ya hao.)
- Karata e phahameng e etsang pot ka showdown.

invalid_move.ambiguous: Nyetse ka har'a setsebi sa mabapi, e.g. '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', kapa '[fold]'.
invalid_move.cannot_check: Ha ho khonehe [check] - u tobane le papali ea chelete.
invalid_move.amount_min: Bet / Phahamisa chelete e lokela ho ba ≥ 1.
invalid_move.cannot_bet: Ha khone ho [bet] - ke hloka ho [call] / [raise] / [fold].
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Ha ho letho leo u ka le bitsang; e-na le hoo, u ka [check].
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Sebelisa [bet X] ho bula; ha ho na bet e ka phahamisoang.
invalid_move.insufficient: Lichips tse sa lekaneng bakeng sa ketso eo.

board.possible_actions: Liketso tsa hao tse ka khonehang: {legal}

message.folded: Sebapali {player_id} se ile sa tlohela papali.
message.showdown_tie: Showdown tie: bobeli {card}. Pitsa e arotsoe  ka 'ngoe ea amohela {split} .
